description: This file defines the ClientEntity class implementing the ClientEntityInterface for OAuth2 client representation within the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates client details such as ID, name, redirect URI, confidentiality status, and display name, with a static factory method to create instances from OAuthClient entity objects.

classes.name: ClientEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 client entity implementing ClientEntityInterface, holding client identification and configuration details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ClientEntity with identifier, name, redirect URI, confidentiality flag, and display name.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI configured for the client.

methods.name: isConfidential
methods.description: Returns whether the client is confidential.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the client.

methods.name: createFromEntity
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance from an OAuthClient entity.
